hypothesis: Can a model-independent hybrid index find the right visible message inside real conversations of 16k, 70k and 250k Qwen tokens without rewriting or semantically cutting those conversations?
private_payload: preserved E007 Codex visible-message inventory v0.2

methods.lexical: deterministic Unicode-token BM25 over complete visible messages
methods.hybrid: reciprocal-rank fusion of dense and lexical rankings with k=60
methods.context_return: selected exact message plus one visible neighbour on each side; source coordinates remain unchanged
